_comment: Fan-out config for --expand. JSON rather than YAML so no new dependency
is needed. Every template x segment x city combination becomes one query,
3 templates x 3 segments x 7 cities = 63 queries. At --num-results 100
that is 126 Serper credits, so check the estimate before running.
Copy this file, edit it, and pass it with:
Watch the BARU column in the yield table: once it trends toward zero the
segment is exhausted and more queries of the same shape only buy overlap.
name: hospitality_jawa_bali
